The '''Old Paths''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] that lay to the west of the mountaintop [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Voss-Ka]]. The [[Shrine of Healing]] was located in the Old Paths, as well as several [[Voss (species)|Voss]] outposts and ancient ruins dating from before the Voss and the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] split into separate [[Species/Legends|species]].
